title: The Fish Shop
lines: Kim has a fish shop on the dock.
She sells fish in a red dish.
A cat runs in and picks up a fish.
It runs off to a shed.
In the shed sit six wet kits!
"We have lots of fish," said Kim.
She fills a dish. The kits dash in.

questions.ask: What does the cat take from the shop?
questions.listenFor: A big fish. It is stated in the story - send them back to that line if they are not sure.

questions.ask: What does Kim find in the shed?
questions.listenFor: Six wet kits - baby cats. If they say only "cats," ask them to find the word that tells how many.

questions.ask: Why do you think Kim fills a dish for the kits?
questions.listenFor: Any reason tied to the story works - "the kits are hungry" or "the cat took a fish to feed them" both show they connected the shed to the ending.
